summary.text: Chris Bishopp is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 82, running against incumbent Republican Brian Echevarria in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Navy veteran and retired federal air traffic controller.

paragraphs.text: Chris Bishopp said in his Ballotpedia survey that his early service was as a Naval Flight Officer in the U.S. Navy, followed by decades of experience in aviation safety, operations and public service.
He listed education among his main campaign messages, saying Cabarrus County schools need to keep pace with the county's growth and criticizing underfunding and voucher expansion.
He also named affordability for working families and retirees, access to health care, and free and fair elections among his priorities.
